title: The default show evidence page keeps a random-id subset, not the newest records
outcome: When an item has more evidence than the default page holds, the page keeps the newest execution records by dense run-feed position, with verification-to-environment closure and spare-slot observations kept.
acceptance: A test with more candidates than the page holds asserts the exact retained membership, its order, the latest record and the omission counts, including a verification whose environment lies beyond the boundary; rich next shows the same selection.

The bounded selection behind the default show and rich next evidence page takes the newest execution records by dense run-feed position instead of descending random evidence id. A verification still brings its linked environment, even one beyond the boundary. Observations still fill only spare slots. The latest record stays independently included.

completion.summary: The bounded evidence page behind the default show and rich next now keeps the run's newest records by dense run-execution feed position instead of a random-id subset. Each selected verification keeps its linked environment, however old. A pair that does not fit is left out whole, environment included; a shared environment takes one slot. Observations fill spare slots and the latest record stays independent. A projected row with no run-feed entry is refused. The position is read-time only, so nothing stored changes.
